sentences.text: KaPa Kala Oy is a newly registered company, entered in the register on 2026-08-29 under the industry code 10200, processing and preserving of fish, crustaceans and molluscs.
First sales are recorded on 2026-08-29, and a start-up notification and a board change were registered on 2026-09-03.
No grant, EU project, public contract or funding record is on file.
For the fund this is a watchlist case: the industry is fish processing, which fits the blue economy, but no public record yet shows technology or growth.
